approved_by_user: 2026-11-08 ("I approve proceeding to M4 with a documented amendment")
evidence_label: VALIDATION (decomposition, controls, hypotheses); TRAIN (mid-site rule input from M3, feature ranking, k choice); test not loaded

amendment_A1_mid_site.why: M3's rule selected near-endpoint sites (L1 slot E=0.97, L11 final E=0.96) where carrying the effect is close to tautological; the handover region (layers 6-8) is where an SAE decomposition is informative (D24).
amendment_A1_mid_site.rule: Among M3 TRAIN cells at blocks.{6,7,8}.hook_resid_pre in groups {slot, final} that passed M3's pre-registered criteria, choose the cell with E_share (train, T1-T4) closest to 0.5 (the handover point), ties -> larger R_A. Confirm on VALIDATION T2-T4 using original activations only: T_full CI low > 0 AND (T_full - T_full_synonym) CI low > 0. If not confirmed, try the next candidate in the same order; if none confirms, proceed with the two fixed sites and report why.
amendment_A1_mid_site.no_sae_used: the selection and confirmation run before any SAE is loaded (scripts/repe/24_*.py: select_mid_site)
amendment_A1_mid_site.disclosure: The M3 train/validation tables were seen before writing this rule; by them the rule picks blocks.8.hook_resid_pre final (train E 0.505). The smoke test (1/10 of pairs) also confirmed it. No SAE result was seen for any mid-layer site before the rule was fixed.

sites: blocks.1.hook_resid_pre persona slot; blocks.11.hook_resid_pre final token; + A1 mid site
saes: 9 base uninterrupted OWT SAEs per site layer (relu/topk/jumprelu x seeds 42/1042/2042), not retrained
pairs: validation: T1-T4 (H/U/Hp) 356 pairs; N1-N2 neutral 178 pairs. train T2-T4 (1251 pairs) only for feature attribution and k.

quantities.differences: Delta = x_H - x_U; Delta_rec = x_hat_H - x_hat_U; Delta_err = e_H - e_U; identity checked (max abs error)
quantities.T(v): KL(p_H||p_U) - KL(p_H||p_{U + v at the site position}), final-token next-token distribution, nats; patched runs start at the site layer from the clean U residual (start_at_layer); v = 0 must reproduce the clean output
quantities.decomposition: T_full, T_rec, T_err, I = T_full - T_rec - T_err, phi_rec/phi_err (two-player Shapley, sum = T_full), linearity T(Delta_rec/2) - T_rec/2
quantities.preservation: T_rec / T_full (ratio of statement means, bootstrap CI); Shapley share phi_rec / T_full; |I| / T_full
quantities.other_direction: H - v toward U: TB_full, TB_rec, TB_err
quantities.synonym_control: Hp run restored toward H with Delta_S = x_H - x_Hp split the same way: S_full, S_rec, S_err; persona-specific preservation T_rec - S_rec
quantities.neutral_control: Nb run restored toward Na (N1, N2) with the same decomposition
quantities.vector_controls: 20 isotropic matched-norm draws for Delta_rec and for Delta_err; 20 decoder-span shuffles (Delta_z permuted across features, rescaled to ||Delta_rec||)

features.patch: U's features F set to H's values, error kept: v_F = W_dec[:, F] (z_H - z_U)[F]; patching all features must equal T_rec
features.ranking: first-order attribution on TRAIN T2-T4: a_j = mean over pairs of -(dz_j W_j) . dKL(p_H||p_{U+v})/dv at v=0; features with |corr(activation, token position)| > 0.3 on OWT validation, and features with zero mean |dz|, excluded
features.k: smallest k in {1,4,16,64} with TRAIN T_F(k) >= 0.5 x TRAIN T_rec (T2-T4), else 64
features.controls_validation: 200 random feature sets matched per feature on (OWT-validation activation-frequency decile x TRAIN mean |dz| decile); 200 isotropic vectors with ||v_F|| per pair; top-|dz| sets (no attribution) at every k
features.interpretation_limit: a feature patch changing the output shows that this SAE-defined direction is causally sufficient when inserted; it does NOT show that GPT-2 uses SAE features

template_sets: PRIMARY = T2-T4 pooled; T1 reported separately as a negative/control case (it did not exceed its synonym control in M3); all T1-T4 also reported; no template excluded from the data

hypotheses_primary_T2_T4.H4a sufficiency: T_rec > controls: paired p of (T_rec - mean isotropic) and (T_rec - mean shuffle), max of the two; BH over SAE x site (27); pass needs q < 0.05, T_rec CI low > 0 and mean T_rec > q95 of both control distributions
hypotheses_primary_T2_T4.H4b rec vs err: phi_rec - phi_err > 0, bootstrap p; BH over 27
hypotheses_primary_T2_T4.H4c features: T_F(k*) > random feature sets: empirical p = (1 + #sets >= T_F)/(1 + 200); BH over 27; pass also needs T_F(k*) CI low > 0
hypotheses_primary_T2_T4.claim_rule: a claim per architecture x site needs >= 2 of 3 seeds passing; additive (Shapley) reading only if |I|/T_full CI high < 0.2, otherwise only the sufficiency (T_rec) and error (T_err) bounds are interpreted

pre_written_readings.high T_rec, low T_err: the SAE reconstruction is behaviourally sufficient at this site
pre_written_readings.low T_rec, high T_err: the behaviour-relevant difference sits in the SAE error (faithfulness failure)
pre_written_readings.H4a holds, H4c fails: the information is in the reconstruction but not concentrated in few features

sanity_checks: identity error < 1e-3; v=0 patch KL < 1e-6; Shapley sum error < 1e-9; all-features patch = T_rec within 1e-4; T_full identical across SAEs; T_full equals M3 validation R_A within 1e-5
smoke_test_disclosure: Ran on 1/10 of the pairs with 3-5 control draws in scratch to check mechanics (fixed: CPU/GPU generator mismatch, inference-tensor in the gradient, decoder-weight grad tracking, a pandas boolean combination). Only sanity values and the mid-site selection were inspected; no hypothesis outcome was inspected.
